nodes.name: Mini-Program Pages
nodes.responsibility: Page layer orchestrating data fetching, component composition, navigation, and user interaction. Pages: forum feed (index), post detail, create post, search, profile, conversation list, chat room.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Components
nodes.responsibility: Reusable glass-easel presentation components: post-card, comment-item, chat-bubble, avatar, empty-state, error-view, nav-bar, loading-skeleton, category-tag. Pure render — no data fetching.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Service Layer
nodes.responsibility: Typed data access boundary. Wraps wx.cloud.database() for reads and wx.cloud.callFunction() for writes. Single module per domain: auth.ts, posts.ts, comments.ts, messages.ts, categories.ts, users.ts. No page calls CloudBase SDK directly.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Watch Manager
nodes.responsibility: Real-time push subscriptions via db.collection().watch(). Manages lifecycle: open, onChange, onError, close. Replaces the deleted mp-ws-client module. Used for live post updates, new comments, and real-time messaging.

nodes.name: Mini-Program Utilities
nodes.responsibility: Shared helpers: date formatting, storage wrapper (wx.Storage typed), LoadState type, debounce, Chinese text utilities. No business logic.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Login
nodes.responsibility: User identity bootstrap. On first call: create user document with openid + nickname + avatar. On subsequent calls: return cached profile. Sync profile updates from WeChat. CloudBase context.OPENID is the trust root.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Posts
nodes.responsibility: Post CRUD business logic. Action dispatch: create (with sensitive word filter), update, delete (soft), flag, search (RegExp). Enforces: title 1-200 chars, content 1-10000 chars, rate limit per user per hour.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Comments
nodes.responsibility: Comment CRUD with nesting enforcement. Action dispatch: create, delete (soft). Enforces: max depth 2 (post→comment→reply), content 1-2000 chars, parent comment must belong to same post.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Messages
nodes.responsibility: Private message send + conversation queries. Action dispatch: send (with dedup via msg_id), listConversations (grouped by other user, last message preview, unread count), getConversation (paginated history). Enforces: content 1-5000 chars, rate limit.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Categories
nodes.responsibility: Category listing and admin management. Action dispatch: list (all active, ordered by sort_order), create (admin only), update (admin only). Read-heavy — client may also read directly from db-categories with permission rules.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Users
nodes.responsibility: User profile read/update. Sync denormalized author data to posts and comments when profile changes. Admin: list users, mute/ban.

nodes.name: Cloud Function — Shared Utilities
nodes.responsibility: Shared cloud function code deployed as a CloudBase '层' (layer). Sensitive word filter list, input validation helpers, error response formatting. Imported by all other cloud functions.

nodes.name: Database Collection — Users
nodes.responsibility: User documents: _openid (PK), nickname, avatar_url, role (user|admin), created_at, updated_at. Permission: all users read, only self write (via cloud function).

nodes.name: Database Collection — Posts
nodes.responsibility: Post documents: title, content, category_id, author (denormalized: nickname, avatar_url), status (published|flagged|hidden|deleted), view_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at. Indexes: (category_id, status, created_at), (status, created_at). Permission: all read, creator write.

nodes.name: Database Collection — Comments
nodes.responsibility: Comment documents: post_id, parent_id (null for top-level), depth (0|1), content, author (denormalized), status, created_at. Indexes: (post_id, status, created_at). Permission: all read, creator write.

nodes.name: Database Collection — Messages
nodes.responsibility: Message documents: msg_id (unique, idempotency), from (openid), to (openid), content, status (sent|delivered|read), created_at. Indexes: (msg_id) unique, (from, to, created_at), (to, from, created_at). Permission: admin-only via cloud function (private data).

nodes.name: Database Collection — Categories
nodes.responsibility: Category documents: name, description, sort_order, post_count, status (active|hidden). Permission: all read, admin write.

nodes.name: WeChat External APIs
nodes.responsibility: WeChat open APIs called via cloud.call (cloud.openapi): getUserProfile, getPhoneNumber, content security check (imgSecCheck, msgSecCheck), template messages. Not called directly — cloud functions mediate all calls.

boundary_conditions.description: CloudBase environment may be uninitialized or wrong environment ID — wx.cloud.init() fails or calls return UNAUTHORIZED
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Service layer catches init failure on first call. Returns structured error {code: 'ENV_INIT_FAILED', message: '...'}. Page shows full-screen error with 'check config' prompt.

boundary_conditions.description: User identity unavailable — context.OPENID is empty (should never happen in mini-program, but guard)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Cloud function returns {error: 'IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE', code: 'AUTH_FAILED'}. Client shows 'please restart mini-program' message. WeChat runtime guarantees OPENID in normal operation — this is a defense-in-depth check.

boundary_conditions.description: watch() subscription fails or exceeds connection/document limits
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: onError handler logs error. Falls back to polling via cloud function every 5 seconds if watch is unavailable. Shows 'connection unstable' banner. watch is preferred path; polling is degraded fallback.

boundary_conditions.description: Cloud function cold start latency (100-800ms) — user perceives slow response on first interaction after inactivity
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Service layer returns normally — cold start is transparent to the caller. UI shows loading skeleton immediately on action (button spinner), so the user sees feedback instantly even if the cloud function takes 800ms.

boundary_conditions.description: Sensitive word filter triggers on user-generated content (post or comment)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Post/comment created with status='flagged' instead of 'published'. Returned to author with 'under review' message. Flagged content not visible to other users in public listings. Admin reviews via CMS or cloud function.

boundary_conditions.description: Message sent to non-existent user — recipient openid not in users collection
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Cloud function validates recipient exists before persisting. Returns 404 error {code: 'USER_NOT_FOUND', message: '...'}. Sender sees 'user not found' toast. Message not persisted.

boundary_conditions.description: WeChat mini-program bundle size limit (2MB main, 12MB subpackages total)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Chat module as independent subpackage (<1MB). Images from CDN, not bundled. Cloud function SDK included in app.json dependencies. Bundle size checked in CI via miniprogram-ci build --analyze.

boundary_conditions.description: Database permission violation — client tries to write to admin-only collection or read private data
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: CloudBase SDK returns UNAUTHORIZED error. mp-services catches and throws typed error. For writes: redirect to cloud function path. For reads: return empty with error logged. Messages collection is admin-only — all access through cloud functions.

boundary_conditions.description: Rate limit exceeded — user creates too many posts/comments/messages in a window
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Cloud function tracks per-user rate in memory (Map<openid, count>). Returns 429 error {code: 'RATE_LIMITED', retry_after: seconds}. Client shows cooldown timer. ponytail: in-memory counters reset on cold start. Add Redis/DB-backed counters if abuse becomes a problem.

boundary_conditions.description: Comment depth exceeds maximum (reply to a reply) — 3rd level nesting attempt
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Cloud function checks parent comment's depth field. If depth >= 1, returns 400 error {code: 'MAX_DEPTH', max: 2}. Client disables reply button on level-2 comments. UX: show 'reply in thread' that creates top-level comment mentioning the user.

notes: Frontend services/ layer is the single data boundary — pages never call CloudBase SDK directly. This allows mock data swap during development and centralized error handling.
mp-watch replaces the deleted mp-ws-client. Watch lifecycle is page-scoped (onLoad → open, onUnload → close). No persistent connections across pages.
Cloud functions use action-based routing: each function receives {action: 'create'|'update'|'delete'|..., ...data}. Single function per domain, not per operation.
cf-utils is deployed as a CloudBase '层' (layer) — shared across all cloud functions without code duplication. Contains: sensitive word list, validation helpers, error formatters.
Database permission model: posts/comments/categories = all read, creator write. messages = admin-only (all access via cloud functions). users = all read public fields, creator write own.
Denormalization strategy: author nickname + avatar stored in post and comment at creation time. cf-users syncs changes to all existing posts/comments when profile updated (eventually consistent).
Full-text search uses db.RegExp() for MVP. If quality is insufficient, create a search index collection where cloud function tokenizes and indexes post content.
ponytail: No Redis, no message queue, no separate search service. CloudBase native capabilities only. Add external services only when measured performance requires it.

Intentional coupling: mp-services calls both cloud functions (writes) AND database directly (simple reads). This is by design — not a layering violation. The service layer abstracts which path is used.

Deleted modules from previous design: be-routes, be-ws-handler, be-session-manager, be-core, be-schemas, be-models, all 5 repos, wechat-api, mp-ws-client, mp-api-client. JWT management in mp-auth replaced by CloudBase native identity.
